text: RESOLVED: implement properly, but in v1.1, not v1.0. Rationale: CRQA is not on the thesis path (raw samples to contrast) and is larger than it looks -- embedding dimension, delay, radius selection, and RR/DET/LAM/ENTR/TT/L_max. Shipping a partial CRQA is worse than shipping none, and v0.4 already carries alignment, MultiMatch, ScanMatch, the distribution family, OT and the metric law suites. Commit it to v1.1 alongside the saliency metric family; it unlocks dual eye tracking and joint-attention work. v1.0 README states the absence. Moving cmp-crqa off the ms-v04 critical path.
